cutoff: qualifying end (interval: scheduled qualifying start to race start)
primary_rule: Sealed 2025 evaluation did not show M1 beating the rank-only baseline (B1); per the pre-registered rule B1 is the primary forecast and M1 is shown for comparison.

input_fingerprints.scope: Actual training features/labels and target features; target outcomes excluded. Canonical sorted JSON with float precision 15; identity evidence, not independent replication.

coverage.policy: Qualifying-row roster only; no independent full entered-roster completeness claim.

note: Qualifying rank is not the final starting grid. Probabilities are independent per driver and need not sum to ten.

source_inventory.scope: Collected input-file identities; actual fitted rows are separately fingerprinted. Raw snapshots are not retained publicly; these hashes do not enable full reproduction alone.
